page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a baseline frequency of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, there are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated rendering or GPU-bound machine learning workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed of 3.1 GHz provide predictable compute capacity for enterprise workloads without the risk of resource contention. The balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this server for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-scale database hosting where local storage is not a prerequisite.
